items.t: ZIPPO — Youth audience expansion & product theme strategy
items.d: Business challenge: carry the brand culture forward and reach younger consumers. Research & insight: we gathered experts from 11 fields to distil 4 major trend directions. Design delivery: an actionable CMF strategy, rolled out across 40–60 products. Success story: 84% new users for hero products, 45% Gen Z user share, and several S-tier products became best-sellers.

items.t: Starbucks — Standardising craft techniques for store artworks
items.d: Business challenge: unify the brand’s art language while meeting craft quality and timelines. Research & insight: we matched 15–20 decorative crafts and set standards through physical samples. Design delivery: reusable craft and application solutions, extended to in-store artwork production. Success story: reusable art craft and application standards that keep brand art consistent across stores.

items.t: FOTILE Bochu — Whole-home customisation experience strategy
items.d: Business challenge: understand how families live today and set the direction for whole-home design. Research & insight: home visits, trend research and designer workshops. Design delivery: we created the “Chaoju” concept and extended it to showroom design. Success story: the “New Chinese” home trend distilled into the “Chaoju” whole-home concept, translated into spatial solutions and showrooms.

items.t: T.W.R.C. — Premium sub-brand of TEENIE WEENIE
items.d: A premium sub-brand in modern Ivy style. As the premium label of TEENIE WEENIE, one visual language links the logo, garment details and store spaces. Success story: precise scenario segmentation rebuilt the growth engine, moving a RMB 3-billion apparel brand upmarket.

One visual framework, extended to every city. Race identity for the city-home 10K series, extended to city KVs and race materials for every stop from 2023 to 2025. Success story: the 2025 Taipei race sold out within 10 minutes of opening, after 3 years building a multi-city identity.

items.t: Unilever EB39 — New premium men’s skincare brand

items.t: Budweiser UniBrew — Community brand identity & experience
